answer: One concrete mechanism: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its pulse recurs, its raven survives audit, and a garden from an unlinked peer confirms it.
